## My Flight Map

<style>
@keyframes popupFadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

.maplibregl-popup {
    z-index: 20;
    animation: popupFadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
}

.dt-buttons {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    float: left !important;
}

.dt-info, .dt-paging {
    padding: 5px;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
    float: none !important;
}


#flight-records thead th, #top-airlines thead th, #top-aircrafts thead th {
    text-align: center;
}

#flight-records tbody td, #top-airlines tbody td, #top-aircrafts tbody td {

    text-align: center;
}

#flight-records  tbody tr, #top-airlines tbody tr, #top-aircrafts tbody tr {
    text-align: center;
} 

.flight-records-container {
    max-width: 900px;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}

.top-airlines-container {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    max-width: 400px;
}
.top-aircrafts-container {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    max-width: 350px;
}

</style>

<div class="map-container">
<div id="map-flight-log"></div>
</div>



<h2> Records </h2>

<div class="flight-records-container">
    <table id="flight-records" class="stripe hover"></table>
</div>

<h2> Top Airlines </h2>

<div class="top-airlines-container">
    <table id="top-airlines" class="stripe hover"> </table>
</div>


<h2> Top Aircrafts </h2>
